Hello,

 

I am conducting bivariate latent growth curve analysis at 8 timepoints. When I fit each of the constructs separately, both constructs fit well with intercept, linear and quadratic slope. When I try to fit them within the same model (bivariate LGCA), however, I get the following error:

 

lavaan WARNING: covariance matrix of latent variables

                is not positive definite

 

From what my understanding is it is because my eigenvalues are negative, and that possibly both constructs are highly correlated. While I understand this, I am not sure what is usually the plan of action, as I do want to examine them separately rather than combining them into one factor.
